profile.style_aesthetic: Old Money / Quiet Luxury / Royal Heritage

approved_fabrics: 100% Pure Flax Linen (French or Irish Linen)
Raw Matka & Tussar Silk (Matte, textured slubs)

cream_off_white_ecru_beige.why: Stark paper-white creates a harsh, chalky contrast against wheatish/brown skin. Warm off-white/cream illuminates the skin's natural golden undertones.

brown_coffee_chocolate_tobacco_cognac.why: Different creators use 'coffee', 'chocolate', and 'tobacco' interchangeably. It is a single foundational earth tone that adds deep luxury when paired with cream, sage, or navy.

olive_hunter_sage_green.why: Sage is the soft daytime muted variant; Olive/Hunter is the deep evening/outerwear variant. Both sit adjacent to warm skin on the color wheel, creating effortless organic elegance.

navy_blue_dark_indigo.why: Replaces stark black. Looks infinitely more expensive, aristocratic, and forgiving in natural sunlight.

charcoal_grey_washed_black.why: Softens the silhouette compared to jet-black and pairs seamlessly with pastel, earth, and jewel tones.

layering_power_accents.effect: Rich, grounded warmth that makes cream and green look bespoke.
Complementary warmth against blue denim; brings instant festive/artistic flair.
Aristocratic depth that enlivens grey and dusty pink bases.
Softens dark trousers and denim; looks fresh under sunlight.
Subtle, understated daytime luxury for kurtas, bandis, and knit tees.

section_C_high_fashion_notes: Mid-wash blue jeans with a navy t-shirt is already easy, but throw on a cream overshirt and suddenly the whole outfit looks ridiculously clean.
Ecru jeans with a sage green t-shirt is already fresh, but add some chocolate brown and now you look expensive as fuck.
Grey jeans with a dusty pink t-shirt is already different, but throw in some burgundy and suddenly the whole outfit has way more personality.
Dark indigo jeans with a powder blue t-shirt is already sharp, but bring in some burnt orange, and now you look like you actually understand color theory.
section_D_layered_color_combos: Light blue overshirt + white inner t-shirt + black pant
Hunter overshirt + white inner t-shirt + cream pant
Cream overshirt + black inner t-shirt + coffee pant

western_outfit_combinations.why_it_works_for_brown_skin: Blue-on-blue denim and navy can look monotone on its own; throwing a warm cream linen overshirt on top creates instant high-contrast brightness that looks ridiculously clean against wheatish skin.

festive_curation_philosophy.theme: Old Money Royal Heritage (Awadhi Nawab & Bengali Zamindar Aesthetic)
festive_curation_philosophy.climate_consideration: Garba/Dandiya dancing and pandal hopping cause intense heat and sweating. 100% breathable natural fabrics (Linen, Khadi, Raw Silk, Cotton-Silk) are mandatory. Strictly zero polyester or cheap synthetic shiny brocades.
festive_curation_philosophy.pandal_convenience: Slip-on footwear (Peshawari sandals, juttis, or loafers) allows effortless entry and exit at temple pandals without untying laces.

outfit_combos.accessories: Vintage gold analog watch on dark brown leather strap, subtle hammered brass buttons

practical_old_money_rules.fabric_rule: Never wear polyester or synthetic art-silks. Natural cotton, linen, khadi, and raw silk have an organic matte texture and natural slubs that synthetic fabrics can never replicate.
practical_old_money_rules.collar_rule: The band/mandarin collar must rest cleanly around the neck without gaping open or choking.
practical_old_money_rules.trouser_break_rule: Trousers, chinos, and pajamas must have a 0-break or very slight break. Bottoms should never puddle or drag on the ground.
practical_old_money_rules.leather_match_rule: Your watch strap, belt, and footwear must match in warmth (e.g. all rich dark brown, or all warm cognac). Never mix black leather shoes with a brown watch strap.
practical_old_money_rules.undergarment_law: Always wear a seamless ribbed 100% breathable cotton sleeveless undershirt beneath light-colored linen shirts and kurtas to prevent sweat marks and preserve drape.
